events.verdict: Okoro (CHI) is in a legal guarding position and absorbs the contact during Cunningham's (DET) driving shot attempt.
Thompson (DET) briefly places a hand on Giddey (CHI) as he starts the drive to the basket, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Harris (DET) maintains a legal guarding position during the drive to the basket by Jones (CHI).

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Jones (CHI) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Robinson (DET) firms up in a screening position in Vucevic's (CHI) path and does not deliver contact.
Duren (DET) establishes a position in Okoro's (CHI) path and the two players briefly engage as they move in the same direction.
Holland II (DET) commits a take foul on Giddey (CHI).
Vucevic (CHI) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Duren (DET) is late to establish a position in Okoro's (CHI) path, but the contact during the screen is marginal.
Vucevic (CHI) maintains a legal guarding position during Cunningham's (DET) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Cunningham (DET) places his off-arm against Okoro (CHI) and releases as he steps back.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Giddey (CHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Prior to the out of bounds, a proximate foul is assessed to Cunningham (DET) for making illegal arm contact to Giddey.
Okoro (CHI) contests the jump shot attempt by Cunningham (DET) and any ensuing contact after the release is marginal.
Vucevic (CHI) directly contests Harris's (DET) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Harris's hand after the release.
Cunningham (DET) makes illegal contact to Giddey's (CHI) arm after he secures the rebound.
